text:
flora: Quick PR incoming to add a short "SELinux + cgroups + socket ownership" troubleshooting blurb for Private installs. Will include a tiny systemd drop-in, tmpfiles note, and a Podman rootless hint. Tagging @raj for unit snippet and @sasha for SDK impacts.

raj: On it. Recommend a dedicated group `redwoodhsm` and a tmpfiles entry so /var/run/redwood exists before services start. Also mention cgroup v2 vs v1 in one line.

sasha: SDK note: support REDWOOD_KMS_SOCKET env var and fallback to tcp://127.0.0.1:9400 in docs so apps don't fail on hosts that forbid unix sockets. Also include a short line about file perms for PKCS11.

flora: Draft snippets (will go under Private installer -> Troubleshooting -> Networking & HSM):

flora: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-resources.conf
[Service]
User=redwoodsvc
Group=redwoodhsm
LimitNOFILE=65536
Slice=redwood.slice
```

flora: ```conf
# /etc/tmpfiles.d/redwood.conf
# create runtime dir on boot
d /var/run/redwood 0750 root redwoodhsm -
```

flora: ```bash
# airgapped manual fixes
sudo mkdir -p /var/run/redwood
sudo chown root:redwoodhsm /var/run/redwood
sudo chmod 0770 /var/run/redwood
# verify socket writable by redwoodsvc
sudo -u redwoodsvc test -w /var/run/redwood/kms.sock && echo OK || echo NEEDS_FIX
# SELinux (RHEL/CentOS) if semanage available
sudo semanage fcontext -a -t container_var_run_t '/var/run/redwood(/.*)?' || echo "install policycoreutils"
sudo restorecon -R /var/run/redwood
```

secops-bot: Security checklist suggestion: avoid symlinks into user-writable paths, restrict PKCS11 dir to group redwoodhsm, document distro package names for semanage fallbacks, and recommend verifying installer checksums for airgapped flows.

docs-bot: CI started for branch flora/selinux-socket-edgecases. Preview: https://docs-internal.redwood.ai/preview/4501 (expires in 24h).

flora: Pushed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4501. Kept the airgap steps short (3 bullets) and added the SDK fallback note. Will merge after secops sign-off.
